svg.aria-label: What's in the box. In the box, three issues: projects in Shift Manager, where workstreams sit under the project the Lab declares and the project's stream, board, workstreams and brief read from the tree, FIX-1718, held on Jake's answer to Q1; the CoS org seat, one document a Lab opts into on the built-in agent kind, declared under org/workers and booted by a Layer 2 change, the only seat that hires, hiring on its own and firing on the person's approval, FIX-1719, whose Q2 Jake answered on 1 October 2026; and orphan repair, which finds stored seats whose kind is gone and retires or re-hires each on approval, FIX-1621, which starts at the gate. Composed from what already ships: channels and CHANNEL.md, boards, teams and TEAM.md, the inventory, durable hire and the seat-hire capability, plane isolation, the agent kind, and Shift Manager's frame. Owned elsewhere: what sits on a workstream's board, FIX-1651; attention, FIX-1652; wake and principal, FIX-1637 and FIX-1645; runtime channel admin, parked under FIX-1415 and FIX-1341; the org subscription registry, FIX-1550. Not built, below a fence: workforce/projects or workforce/agents folders; Layer 1 Agent, Team, Channel, Project or Workstream; a CoS or admin-seat type; a second hire store; an org-owned hire cell; an automatic mapping of a cut kind onto another; multi-user org productization; Heartbeats or Paperclip; a CHANNELS.md convention.

g.text: IN THE BOX — WHAT ONE PERSON GETS FROM THE LAB'S OWN TREE
